{{Top}}
[[File:Star_Wars_RPG_Blast_Helmet_And_Vest.jpg|thumb|An illustration of a blast helmet and vest.]]

The '''blast helmet''' was a lightweight helmet that could withstand various types of impact to a limited degree. It was typically sold with a matching [[Blast vest/Legends|composite vest]]. The pair could provide limited protection against shrapnel, [[Melee/Legends|melee]] weapons, [[Slugthrower/Legends|slugthrowers]], and [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]]. The helmet itself cost 300 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="SW:TRPGRE">''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition, Revised and Expanded]]''</ref> The pair cost 500 credits and weighed roughly three [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]].
